def solution(a, b):
    i = 0
    while a <= b:
        a = a * 3
        b = b * 2
        i += 1
    return i

    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    a = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    result = solution(a, b)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
